name: Passage to Booty Bay
summary: This errand traces the missing Sentinel Velinde Starsong across the Great Sea to the lawless haven of Booty Bay. Following shipping logs uncovered by Wharfmaster Dizzywig, Alliance travelers must journey from Ratchet to the Eastern Kingdoms in search of a goblin caravan driver named Ruzzgot.

sections.title: A Trail Across the Sea
sections.body: The search for the night elf Sentinel Velinde Starsong leads away from the familiar boughs of Ashenvale and onto the ocean trade lanes. In the bustling goblin port of Ratchet, Wharfmaster Dizzywig eventually unearths old shipping manifests confirming that Velinde booked passage aboard a vessel named the Black Osprey, bound directly for the pirate haven of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: The Road to Booty Bay
sections.body: Reaching Booty Bay requires boarding the neutral goblin trans-oceanic ferry running between Ratchet and the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms. Upon arrival, the trail narrows toward Caravaneer Ruzzgot, a goblin transport master Dizzywig recommended to Velinde when she inquired about dangerous overland journeys through the southern wilderness.

faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a night elf priestess who led the effort in Ashenvale to hold back the demonic presence in Felwood. Her efforts slowly faltered until she disappeared, and the Sentinels are now tracing her journey across the sea.

faq.q: Why did Velinde travel to Booty Bay?
aliases: why did she go to booty bay
faq.answer: Booty Bay is the primary maritime hub connecting central Kalimdor to the southern Eastern Kingdoms. Velinde needed passage across the Great Sea, and the Black Osprey out of Ratchet offered direct transit toward the human and dwarven kingdoms, where she asked about overland travel.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig manages the shipping docks in Ratchet for the Steamwheedle Cartel. Known for his impatient demeanor, he maintains the port's logbooks and passage manifests for all vessels traveling between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
Caravaneer Ruzzgot is a goblin teamster based in Booty Bay who coordinates supply convoys and overland transport through the dangerous jungles of Stranglethorn Vale and beyond.
According to Wharfmaster Dizzywig's shipping records, Velinde Starsong booked passage aboard the Black Osprey, which made a successful voyage from Ratchet across the Great Sea to Booty Bay.

faq.q: How do I travel to Booty Bay from Ratchet?
aliases: how to get to booty bay
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel operates a passenger ferry directly from the southern dock in Ratchet across the Great Sea, docking in the pirate port of Booty Bay on the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: Finding Velinde Starsong is an urgent duty for the Kaldorei, as her disappearance with the Scythe of Elune left behind a lingering, dangerous mystery in the forests of Ashenvale.
Navigating neutral goblin territory like Ratchet and Booty Bay requires patience and diplomacy, forcing Alliance travelers to deal with mercenaries and cartel bureaucrats.
